content: {"like":["Values strong, well-executed musical performances and choreography, especially when iconic performers collaborate;","Appreciates films that showcase high production quality in sets, costumes, and music;","Enjoys nuanced character portrayals and balanced storytelling;","Prefers films that highlight standout individual performances and memorable dance numbers;","Values films that maintain technical clarity and avoid over-the-top gimmicks."],"dislike":["Dislikes technical shortcomings such as poor photography, unrealistic stage setups, or problematic filming of solos;","Criticizes weak or underdeveloped character roles, especially when a star is sidelined;","Finds dated or unmemorable musical scores and opening numbers off-putting;","Rejects films that rely on gimmicks or overemphasize ego at the expense of skill;","Disapproves of poorly written scripts, weak performances, or films that feel like a joke."]}
